args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the fixed version in the 2.x line.

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## CI

CI passed on branch `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` (run `ci-0001`).

Requesting review from @alex.

1. **Confirmed the vulnerability**: Looked up CVE-2026-31337 — fastjson <2.9.4 (and 3.0.0–<3.1.0) is affected by unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; `2.9.4` is the fixed version in the 2.x line.

2. **Created a branch**: `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from `main`.

3. **Upgraded the pin**: Updated `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` and committed it.

4. **Ran CI**: Triggered CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — it **passed**.

5. **Opened a PR**: Opened [PR #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337", requesting review from **alex**.

The PR is open and awaiting review; I did not merge it since merging into main requires code-owner approval.
